quickAnswers.leave_at_door: Please leave it at the door

setup.camera.existing: The panel's camera is in ViON already: choose it in the list of cameras.
setup.camera.onvif: Turn on ONVIF and RTSP in the panel's web page; a camera not in ViON yet gets its RTSP address in the next step.
setup.changePassword: Change the panel's default administrator password.
setup.generic.button: Add the call button to ViON as a doorbell sensor of the panel's camera.
setup.generic.lock: The lock or relay: a lock or switch sensor in ViON.
setup.hikvision.isapi: Turn on ISAPI (Configuration → Network → Advanced → Integration Protocol) and a digest login.
setup.hikvision.sipOrCloud: Some models work either over SIP or through Hik-Connect: with the cloud on, the ring may not come over ISAPI.
setup.hook.actionUrl: In the panel's web page, set the address for events (Action URL, HTTP notification): ViON shows it once the panel is saved.
setup.rubetek.actionUrl: RUBITEK: under Action URL (or Action → HTTP), set the address ViON shows after saving for the "call" event.
setup.rubetek.relayHttp: RUBITEK: allow opening the relays over HTTP (Relay) for this login.
setup.rubetek.sipDirect: RUBITEK: in the SIP settings, turn on direct IP calls without registration and set the call button to sip:vion@<ViON address>:{port}.
setup.sip.localOnly: SIP works on the home network only: do not forward port {port} to the internet.
